title: Journal Dashboard
caption: Journal
text:
<$ss.hero title="Daily Journal" subtitle="User-space dashboard using generic $ss.hero and $ss.grid widgets"/>
<$ss.grid min="300px">
<$list filter="[all[tiddlers]tag[Journal]!sort[created]limit[12]]">
<$ss.card badge={{!!mood}}><$transclude mode="block"/></$ss.card>
</$list>
</$ss.grid>

title: Project Dashboard
caption: Projects
text:
<$ss.hero title="Projects" subtitle="User-space dashboard using generic $ss.card and $ss.progress widgets"/>
<$ss.grid min="280px">
<$list filter="[all[tiddlers]tag[Project]sort[priority]]">
<$ss.card badge={{!!status}} accent={{!!color}}><$transclude mode="block"/></$ss.card>
</$list>
</$ss.grid>

title: Media Hub
caption: Media
text:
<$ss.hero title="Media Library" subtitle="User-space media hub using generic $ss.grid and $ss.card widgets"/>
<$ss.grid min="160px">
<$list filter="[all[tiddlers]tag[Media]!sort[modified]limit[24]]">
<$ss.card badge={{!!media-type}}><$transclude mode="block"/></$ss.card>
</$list>
</$ss.grid>
